newsitem.title: USA: Clinton critcizes Republican tax bills, offers own.
newsitem.headline: Clinton critcizes Republican tax bills, offers own.

text.p: President Clinton criticized Republican tax bills on Monday, saying they are not consistent with the balanced budget agreement and threaten to balloon the deficit after 2002.

"I do not believe they represent the best way to cut taxes nor are they consistent with the balanced budget agreement," Clinton told reporters. "They include time-bomb tax cuts that threaten to explode the deficit."
The president presented his own $85 billion tax-cut proposal that he said directed more of its relief at the middle class than the Republican bills.
